title: Wildfly: opentelemetry-java is the Java implementation of the OpenTelemetry API for recording telemetry, and SDK for…
description: A security vulnerability affects the Wildfly package versions prior to 42.0.0-r1. The issue involves the opentelemetry-java component, which is the Java implementation of the OpenTelemetry API and SDK used for telemetry recording and management. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.3 and impacts availability without affecting confidentiality or integrity. A patch is available in version 42.0.0-r1.
